arxiv-2102-13206.title: Neutron Interferometry and axion like particles
arxiv-2102-13206.creator: Antonio Capolupo, Salvatore Marco Giampaolo, Aniello Quaranta
arxiv-2102-13206.description: Abstract We propose a method to reveal axions and axion–like particles based on interferometric measurement of neutron beams. We consider an interferometer in which the neutron beam is split in two sub–beams propagating in regions with differently oriented magnetic fields.

arxiv-2208-04283.title: LWGNet: Learned Wirtinger Gradients for Fourier Ptychographic Phase Retrieval
arxiv-2208-04283.creator: Atreyee Saha, Salman S Khan, Sagar Sehrawat, Sanjana S Prabhu, Shanti Bhattacharya, Kaushik Mitra
arxiv-2208-04283.description: Abstract Fourier Ptychographic Microscopy (FPM) is an imaging procedure that overcomes the traditional limit on Space-Bandwidth Product (SBP) of conventional microscopes through computational means. It utilizes multiple images captured using a low numerical aperture (NA) objective and enables high-resolution phase imaging through frequency domain stitching.

arxiv-2304-00556.title: Error estimates for Gaussian beams at a fold caustic Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2304-00556.creator: Olivier Lafitte, Olof Runborg ∗
arxiv-2304-00556.description: Abstract . In this work we show an error estimate for a first order Gaussian beam at a fold caustic, approximating time-harmonic waves governed by the Helmholtz equation. For the caustic that we study the exact solution can be constructed using Airy functions and there are explicit formulae for the Gaussian beam parameters.

arxiv-2305-19928.title: Supplementary Features of BiLSTM for Enhanced Sequence Labeling
arxiv-2305-19928.creator: Conglei Xu, Kun Shen, Hongguang Sun
arxiv-2305-19928.description: Abstract Sequence labeling tasks require the computation of sentence representations for each word within a given sentence. A prevalent method incorporates a Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) layer to enhance the sequence structure information. However, empirical evidence Li (2020) suggests that BiLSTM’s capacity to produce sentence representations for sequence labeling tasks is inherently limited [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2307-03110.title: LISSNAS: Locality-based Iterative Search Space Shrinkage for Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2307-03110.creator: Bhavna Gopal, Arjun Sridhar, Tunhou Zhang, Yiran Chen
arxiv-2307-03110.description: Abstract Search spaces hallmark the advancement of Neural Architecture Search (NAS). Large and complex search spaces with versatile building operators and structures provide more opportunities to brew promising architectures, yet pose severe challenges on efficient exploration and exploitation. Subsequently, several search space shrinkage methods optimize by selecting a single sub-region that contains some well-performing networks.

arxiv-2403-02510.title: On the onset of slip at adhesive elastic interfaces
arxiv-2403-02510.creator: Vineet Dawara, Koushik Viswanathan
arxiv-2403-02510.description: Abstract The transition from static to dynamic friction when an elastic body is slid over another is now known to result from the motion of interface rupture fronts. These fronts may be either crack-like or pulse-like, with the latter involving reattachment in the wake of the front.

arxiv-2503-18538.title: The Phase Induced Amplitude Apodizer and Nuller
arxiv-2503-18538.creator: N. Blind, N. Restori, B. Chazelas, C. Lovis, J. Kühn, C. Mordasini
arxiv-2503-18538.description: Abstract Context. Proxima Cen b is the prime target for the search of life around a nearby exoplanet by characterizing its atmosphere in reflected light. Due to the very high star/companion contrast ( ≤ 10 − 6 \leq 10^{-6} ), High Dispersion Coronagraphy is the most promising technique to perform such a characterization. Aims.

arxiv-2504-21292.title: Can We Achieve Efficient Diffusion without Self-Attention? Distilling Self-Attention into Convolutions
arxiv-2504-21292.creator: Ziyi Dong, Chengxing Zhou, Weijian Deng, Pengxu Wei, Xiangyang Ji, Liang Lin
arxiv-2504-21292.description: Abstract Contemporary diffusion models built upon U-Net or Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures have revolutionized image generation through transformer-based attention mechanisms. The prevailing paradigm has commonly employed self-attention with quadratic computational complexity to handle global spatial relationships in complex images, thereby synthesizing high-fidelity images with coherent visual semantics.

arxiv-2508-00965.title: VAULT: Vigilant Adversarial Updates via LLM-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation for NLI
arxiv-2508-00965.creator: Roie Kazoom, Ofir Cohen, Rami Puzis, Asaf Shabtai, Ofer Hadar
arxiv-2508-00965.description: Abstract We introduce VAULT , a fully automated adversarial RAG pipeline that systematically uncovers and remedies weaknesses in NLI models through three stages: retrieval , adversarial generation , and iterative retraining . First, we perform balanced few‑shot retrieval by embedding premises with both semantic (BGE) and lexical (BM25) similarity.

arxiv-2601-04233.title: LEMAS: A 150K-Hour Large-scale Extensible Multilingual Audio Suite with Generative Speech Models
arxiv-2601-04233.creator: Zhiyuan Zhao †, Lijian Lin, Ye Zhu, Kai Xie, Yunfei Liu, Yu Li
arxiv-2601-04233.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zhiyuan Zhao †, Lijian Lin, Ye Zhu, Kai Xie, Yunfei Liu, Yu Li. Generative speech models have achieved strong performance in high-resource languages such as English and Chinese, yet their capabilities remain limited in multilingual settings. This gap is largely driven by data challenges: collecting and curating large-scale multilingual speech with consistent quality and fine-grained temporal annotations is substantially more difficult, while existing web-crawled corpora provide limited guarantees on data quality and annotation reliability in multilingual settings.

arxiv-2601-16292.title: AMBER: A Columnar Architecture for High-Performance Agent-Based Modeling in Python
arxiv-2601-16292.creator: Anh-Duy Pham
arxiv-2601-16292.description: Abstract Agent-based modeling (ABM) has emerged as an indispensable methodology for studying complex adaptive systems across the natural and social sciences. However, Python-based ABM frameworks face a fundamental tension between the accessibility that has made Python dominant in scientific computing and the performance requirements of large-scale simulations.

arxiv-2602-04506.title: Strain tunable anomalous Hall and Nernst conductivities in compensated ferrimagnetic Mn 3 Al
arxiv-2602-04506.creator: Guihyun Han 1, Minkyu Park 1,2, S. H. Rhim 1
arxiv-2602-04506.description: Abstract The tunability of anomalous Hall and Nernst conductivities is investigated in the compensated ferrimagnet Mn 3 Al under isotropic strain ( η \eta ) and chemical potential variation using first-principles calculations. At a chemical potential of μ = − 0.3 \mu=-0.

britannica-1911-martinet.title: Martinet (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-martinet.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-martinet.description: Article 'Martinet' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. disparaging than in a complimentary sense) implying a strict disciplinarian or drill-master. The term originated in the French army about the middle of Louis XIV.’s reign, and was derived from Jean Martinet (d. 1672), who as lieutenant-colonel of the King’s regiment of foot and inspector-general of infantry drilled and trained that arm in the model regular army created by Louis and Louvois between 1660 and 1670.

pmc-10618538.title: The impact and complete genome characterisation of viruses involved in outbreaks of gastroenteritis in a farrow-to-finish holding
pmc-10618538.creator: Dragan Brnić, Dunja Vlahović, Andrea Gudan Kurilj, Nadica Maltar-Strmečki, Ivana Lojkić, Valentina Kunić, Lorena Jemeršić, Ivica Bačani, Gordan Kompes, Relja Beck, Tina Mikuletič, Andrej Steyer
pmc-10618538.description: Viral enteric pathogens continuously burden intensive pig farming, causing gastrointestinal diseases of epidemic and endemic nature. The present study investigated two diarrhoea outbreaks on a large farrow-to-finish holding and subsequent circulation of outbreak-related enteric viruses. These viruses were characterised by whole genome sequencing, and statistical evaluation of the impact on specific production metrics was performed.

pmc-11507413.title: Risk Factors Associated with Unplanned Hospitalization Among Long-Term Care Facility Residents: A Retrospective Study in Central Taiwan
pmc-11507413.creator: Chiu-Hsiang Lee, Yu-An Chen, Chiu-Ming Yang, Kuang-Hua Huang, Tung-Han Tsai, Yuanmay Chang, Shwn-Huey Shieh, Grażyna Bączyk, Dorota Formanowicz
pmc-11507413.description: Most residents of long-term care facilities (LTCFs) are patients with chronic diseases requiring long-term care. Unplanned hospitalization of older and frailer residents from LTCFs reduces their mobility and increases the number of infections, complications, and falls that might lead to severe disability or death.

pmc-11623797.title: Cultural, social, and economic influences on academic field choice among Jewish and Muslim students
pmc-11623797.creator: Michael Zouari, Zeev Shtudiner
pmc-11623797.description: This study investigated the complex cultural, social, and economic factors influencing the choice of academic field among Jewish and Muslim students in Israeli higher education. By employing a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative surveys and conjoint analysis, this research revealed significant differences between the two groups.

pmc-11897727.title: Genome editing in cells of apple cultivar ‘Fuji’ using geminivirus-derived replicons for transient expression of CRISPR/Cas9 components
pmc-11897727.creator: Katsuya Negishi, Masaki Endo, Tomoko Endo, Chikako Nishitani
pmc-11897727.description: The clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)/CRISPR-associated protein 9 (Cas9) system has been used for genome editing in various fruit trees, including apple (Malus × domestica). In previous studies, transfer DNA (T-DNA) expressing genome editing tools, Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9) and single guide RNA (sgRNA), was stably integrated into the apple genome via Agrobacterium-mediated transformation.

pmc-12604252.title: Polymorphism of the dihydropteroate synthase resistance gene of Plasmodium falciparum in three hospitals in Mbouda, Western Cameroon
pmc-12604252.creator: Noumedem Anangmo Christelle Nadia, Yamssi Cedric, Guemegne Anaiss Patricia Line, Tchuenkam Kom Pacome, Gamago Nkadeu Guy Armand, Noumedem Kenfack Jaurès Anaud, Djeussi Doriane Esther, Guela Djoukou Mba Edna, Kana Tsague Yval, Mpoame Mbida, Zhong Fuyou, Haibo Hu
pmc-12604252.description: BackgroundMalaria, is an endemic disease which causes significant mortality worldwide, particularly in Africa, including Cameroon. This study aimed to characterize the Pfdhps resistance gene of Plasmodium falciparum in three hospitals in Mbouda Cameroon.MethodTwo hundred and ninety-six samples were collected from consenting patients for rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) and thick blood smear (TBS) to determine parasite intensity.

pmc-13335966.title: tBid‐Mediated Genetic Ablation of Connective Tissue Cells Reveals Their Key Regulatory Function During Limb Regeneration in Axolotls
pmc-13335966.creator: Yan Hu, Weimin Feng, Zitian He, Jiayi Zeng, Jingyi Tang, Shulin Li, Tongbo Yu, Sulei Fu, Hui Ma, Binbin Lu, Yanmei Liu, Ji‐Feng Fei
pmc-13335966.description: Vertebrate limb regeneration in adulthood is a fascinating phenomenon unique to salamanders, requiring precise coordination and interaction of various cell types. Connective tissue (CT) constitutes a major component of the limb and serves as the primary reservoir of positional information during regeneration. However, the role and extent of CT cell contribution remain largely undefined.

pmc-13381738.title: Climate change exacerbates disparities of energy resilience in New York City
pmc-13381738.creator: Luo Xu, Ning Lin, A T D Perera, Aaron C Spaulding, Zhecheng Wang, Michael Oppenheimer, Christine Y Blackshaw, H Vincent Poor
pmc-13381738.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Climate extremes increasingly threaten energy infrastructure, yet whether disparities in energy resilience persist within cities under comparable hazard exposure and how distributed energy resources may reshape them remain largely unquantified. By integrating climate and energy projections, socio-demographic data, and an optimization-based power outage metric that captures initial outages, recovery, and distributed energy resource support, this study reveals evident energy resilience disparities shaped by intersectionality across income, race, and ethnicity in New York City.
